notes.title: Scope Battle Royale Early Access
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="afax0pT1RpA;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]Scope Battle Royale Early Access[/h1][p][/p][p]Scope, the new 100 player PVP battle royale game is launching in early access on July 12th, 2025.[/p][p]This gives players the chance to test the game in a early stage of development and give feedback on what needs to be changed or added. The game is in a early stage of development, so players should expect bugs, rough animations and lots of content updates. [/p][p]We plan to launch the game in full release in 3-5 months, then we will start seasons. [/p][p][/p][p]Remember, Operation Games is a small team of teens making video games. So don't get to out of hand, we will try our very best to make this a fun experience. [/p]
